text:
{
  "claims": [
    {
      "anchor": "The WAL-reset bug was found on 2026-03-03",
      "claim_text": "The WAL-reset bug was found on 2026-03-03.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states Dan found and fixed the bug on that date."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the fixed release, 3.51.3, came out about ten days later",
      "claim_text": "Version 3.51.3 was released about ten days after 2026-03-03.",
      "kind": "date",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P0.S0", "rel": "entails"},
        {"sid": "P1.S1", "rel": "entails"}
      ],
      "check": {"kind": "date", "from": "2026-03-03", "to": "2026-03-13", "unit": "days", "op": "==", "value": "10"},
      "reasoning": "Bug found 2026-03-03; 3.51.3 dated 2026-03-13."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "The bug is likely present in releases going back to 3.7.0",
      "claim_text": "The bug is likely present in all SQLite versions from 3.7.0 onward.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage says likely present from 3.7.0 through 3.51.2."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "3.7.0 from July 2010",
      "claim_text": "Version 3.7.0 was released in July 2010.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage gives 3.7.0 date as 2010-07-21."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "it went unnoticed for more than fifteen years",
      "claim_text": "The bug went unnoticed for more than fifteen years.",
      "kind": "date",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P1.S0", "rel": "entails"},
        {"sid": "P0.S0", "rel": "entails"}
      ],
      "check": {"kind": "date", "from": "2010-07-21", "to": "2026-03-03", "unit": "years", "op": ">", "value": "15"},
      "reasoning": "From 2010-07-21 to 2026-03-03 is over 15 years."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "SQLite 3.51.2, released in January 2026, is likely affected",
      "claim_text": "SQLite 3.51.2, released in January 2026, is likely affected by the bug.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage says bug likely present through 3.51.2 (2026-01-09)."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the backports to 3.44.6 and 3.50.7 shipped on the same day as 3.51.3",
      "claim_text": "Backports to 3.44.6 and 3.50.7 shipped on the same day as 3.51.3.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": false,
      "evidence": [],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passages mention backports exist but give no release date for them."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "A single-threaded application that only ever opens one connection cannot hit the bug",
      "claim_text": "An application with only one database connection cannot hit the bug.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Bug requires two or more connections; contrapositive holds."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the developers could only trigger it with a special test hook",
      "claim_text": "The developers could only trigger the bug with a special test hook.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage says only way was modifying sources to invoke test callback."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the bug has never been reproduced without modified SQLite sources",
      "claim_text": "The bug has never been reproduced without modified SQLite sources.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": false,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P4.S3", "rel": "entails"},
        {"sid": "P5.S0", "rel": "refutes"}
      ],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P4.S3 supports it, but P5.S0 update says a reproducer without the hack exists."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Its observed rate in the wild is no higher than the expected rate of SSD malfunctions",
      "claim_text": "The observed occurrence rate in the wild is less than or equal to the expected rate of SSD malfunctions.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states occurrence rate is less than or equal to SSD malfunction rate."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "unless you are doing something really unusual you are unlikely to ever encounter it",
      "claim_text": "Unless you are doing something really unusual, you are unlikely to ever encounter the bug.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S3", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states this for unpatched versions; claim generalizes slightly but matches wording."
    }
  ]
}
